WITH search_campaigns AS
  (SELECT campaign_id,
          name,
          channel
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.campaigns`
   WHERE LOWER(channel) = 'search' ),
     daily_spend AS
  (SELECT s.spend_date,
          SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.ad_spend` s
   JOIN search_campaigns c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE s.spend_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-10'
   GROUP BY s.spend_date),
     daily_leads AS
  (SELECT l.created_date,
          COUNT(l.lead_id) AS total_leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.leads` l
   JOIN search_campaigns c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE l.created_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-10'
   GROUP BY l.created_date),
     all_dates AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT spend_date AS dt
   FROM daily_spend
   UNION DISTINCT SELECT DISTINCT created_date AS dt
   FROM daily_leads)
SELECT d.dt AS date,
       COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS total_spend_eur,
       COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0) AS total_leads,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0), COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0)) AS cost_per_lead_eur,
       SUM(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0)) OVER () AS period_total_spend_eur,
                                            SUM(COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0)) OVER () AS period_total_leads,
                                                                                 SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0)) OVER (), SUM(COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0)) OVER ()) AS period_cost_per_lead_eur
FROM all_dates d
LEFT JOIN daily_spend s ON d.dt = s.spend_date
LEFT JOIN daily_leads l ON d.dt = l.created_date
ORDER BY d.dt;
